jobs.occupation: IT System Administrator (m/f/d) with a focus on Network & Databasebank (IT-Administrator/in)
jobs.description:
To support our site in Jena, we are looking to hire, at the earliest possible date, a permanent (40 hours/week)

IT System Administrator (m/f/d) with a focus on Network & Database

Compugraphics Jena GmbH is a subsidiary of Element Solutions Inc. As a leading manufacturer of precision components for the microelectronics industry, we offer a wide range of microtechnology services, including the development, production, and optimization of components.

We place great emphasis on quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, and maintain strict quality control processes to ensure that all products meet the highest standards.

The aim of the position is to ensure stable, secure and efficient IT operations through the professional support and further development of the IT infrastructure, especially in the areas of system administration, networks and database management

Tasks and Responsibilities

- User management and assignment of rights in Active Directory
- Installation, configuration and maintenance of Windows and Linux systems
- Monitoring and maintenance of the server landscape (Windows & Linux)
- Support network infrastructure (switches, routers, firewalls) under guidance of IT network team.
- Endpoint setup and management and enrolment of corporate PCs (via script, Intune and ManageEngine)
- Support and further development of our FileMaker databases with necessary change management.
- Planning and execution of backups and disaster recovery
- Patch and update management for operating systems and applications
- Support and training of employees in IT matters
- Documentation of IT infrastructure and systems
- Implementation of security systems/updates/policies under guidance of IT security.
- Inventory management of hardware and software
- Performance monitoring of productive database systems
- Plan and execute system migrations and upgrades
- Coordination of external service providers if required
- Support for IT projects and the introduction of new systems
- Manage IT tickets and ensure timely closure of incidents and requests

Requirements ad Qualifications

- Completed training in the IT sector (e.g. IT specialist in system integration) or comparable qualification
- Sound knowledge of Windows and Linux system administration
- Experience with Active Directory and User Management
- Good knowledge of network technology (switches, VLAN, firewalls, routing)
- Experience with endpoint management (ideally Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine)
- Basic knowledge of database management – FileMaker is particularly advantageous
- Experience with backup and recovery solutions
- Structured, independent and solution-oriented way of working
- High sense of responsibility and ability to work in a team
- Very good written and spoken German, Good English
- Experience with Telephony support (Mobile and PBX) 
- Experience of an ITSM system for IT Tickets, Change Requests etc.
- ITIL Foundation preferred

IPG Photonics GmbH & Co. KG is the German subsidiary of IPG Photonics Corporation, the world’s leading manufacturer of high-performance fiber lasers and amplifiers, primarily used in material processing and a wide range of other applications. For our Supply Chain Management team at our Burbach site (NRW), we are looking for a qualified candidate to join us as

Global Transport Manager (m/f/d)

Your tasks:

- Develop and implement a global transport strategy balancing cost, service, and sustainability
- Optimize multimodal transportation networks and manage global material flows
- Establish and monitor KPIs to track and improve transport performance
- Negotiate and manage logistics service providers, ensuring compliance with service level agreements
- Ensure efficient transport operations and drive the implementation of digital tools for visibility and automation
- Ensure compliance with international trade, customs, and regulatory requirements and manage associated risks
- Take ownership of transport budgets and drive cost optimization initiatives
- Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and support global projects and initiatives

Your profile:

- Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field
- Several years of experience in global transport management within an industrial environment
- Strong knowledge of international transport processes, Incoterms, and customs regulations
- Experience with transport management systems (TMS)Strong analytical skills with experience in cost and performance management
- Strong communication and negotiation skills, with experience in international matrix organizations
- Fluent in English; German is a plus
- Willingness to travel

What we offer:

- A collaborative and international working environment in a successful technology company
- Competitive compensation package including salary, bonus, and additional benefits
- Modern workplace and equipment
- Employee benefits such as pension plans and employee stock programs
- Comprehensive health and wellness initiatives
- Access to a wide range of employee discounts and perks

If you are looking to make an impact in a dynamic, global environment and contribute with your own initiative, this role is for you.

We look forward to receiving your application via our careers website or by email, including your salary expectations and earliest possible start date.

Since our beginnings at Dr. Oetker, we have been breaking new ground. With pizza, cake, and desserts, as well as digital platforms and services - quality and an innovative spirit set us apart.

What awaits you? It's up to you! At Dr. Oetker, you can actively shape the future - both yours and ours. We want to be part of something bigger. Don't you?

JOIN THE TASTE.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- As an Application Product Owner - Innovation Management (m/f/d), you will support and develop the Clarity application. This involves analysing business requirements, developing suitable system solutions, and ensuring the application is user-friendly and business processes are mapped efficiently.
- Your responsibilities will include identifying and implementing opportunities to optimise existing processes and structures. In addition, you will contribute to application-related working groups and projects.
- You will coordinate rollouts, system changes, and new functionalities. Furthermore, you will advise and support users on business-related topics and resolve application issues by developing appropriate solutions.
- You will also be responsible for creating and maintaining training materials, system documentation, and user guides, as well as conducting training sessions and workshops.
- Working closely with the IT and Application Management teams, as well as external service providers, you will gather, analyse, and document business requirements. You will prioritize enhancement requests, create functional concepts and test cases, and support business testing activities as well as the implementation of new functionalities.
- With a focus on data quality and reporting, you will support business departments in maintaining high standards of data quality. You will analyse data, create standard reports and dashboards, identify data inconsistencies, and contribute to the further development of reporting and analytics capabilities.
- In collaboration with various business functions, IT, and other stakeholders, you will help ensure the efficient use of systems, identify and implement improvement measures, and contribute ideas for the further development of existing processes and applications. You will also actively participate in cross-functional projects.

WHAT YOU BRING

- You have successfully completed a degree in Business Informatics, Business Administration, Innovation Management, or a related subject with a focus on IT applications, business processes, project management, or digital solutions.
- You have several years of professional experience in Application Management, Product Ownership, Project Management, or a comparable role focused on the support and continuous improvement of business applications.
- Ideally, you have knowledge of project and portfolio management, as well as experience with Clarity or similar applications. In addition, you are familiar with innovation management processes, such as Idea2Launch, Stage-Gate-processes, or similar frameworks.
- You are proficient in agile, hybrid and demand management methodologies, including backlog prioritisation, release planning, and value-driven product development. You are experienced in developing product visions and roadmaps and translating business strategies into scalable system solutions, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
- You have a strong affinity for data governance, portfolio transparency, reporting analytics, and data-driven decision-making. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills distinguish you.
- You think strategically, analytically, and commercially, and work a in structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented manner. Furthermore, you have a proven ability to prioritise competing requirements effectively, derive sound business cases and make recommendations.
- Excellent German and English language skills would complete your profile.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

- Attractive remuneration
- Flexible work models & mobile work
- 30 days of vacation plus Special vacation at Christmas & New Year's Eve
- Onboarding and professional development opportunities
- Excellent employee restaurant and discounts in the Dr. Oetker Shop
- Events and celebrations ​
- Sports, health and fitness offers
- Pension plan, Sabbatical and JobRad
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP), this offers professional support in all situations, such as assistance with childcare, finding au pairs, and advice on care services
- Daycare cooperation for children, holiday childcare and laundry service

jobs.occupation: Steam Turbine Commissioning Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Angewandte Mechanik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

On a customer project somewhere in the world:
After the morning briefing, you will go to the site - switch on pumps, motors, etc. and start them up. Other possible steps follow: - Solving unexpected problems - Setting control parameters and performing tests - Communicating with other engineers (f/m/d). At the end of the day, you will be proud and satisfied about what you have achieved so far and know that you have brought an energy power plant one step closer to
completion.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Perform commissioning of turbines starting from single component to the full system (Turbine and auxiliaries) according to specifications and
* engineering documents, including functional tests and logic interlocks verification and reports
* Compile records to document condition of equipment and assure quality, provide required documentation and reports in accordance with the
* procedure
* Prepare and execute tests to proof operation readiness
* Independent provision of services for power plant components (gas and steam turbine generator sets, electrolysers, battery storage systems)
* worldwide
* Carry out troubleshooting, recording as well as analyzing customer problems and proposing remedial measures, which you may carry out
* yourself
* Your office is the world - and our challenges are more exciting than any traditional desk job

What You Bring

* Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering, Several years of professional experience as a Steam Turbine Commissioning Engineer is
* required
* Understanding of technical equipment and ability to work with / based on technical documentation
* Basic knowledge of general power plant technology
* Experience in power plant operations and maintenance and / or specific Siemens Steam turbine operations and maintenance know-how is a plus
* Excellent knowledge of German and English suitable for everyday use
* Strong analytical skills with an affinity to technology and innovation combined with a proactive and convincing attitude
* Team player attitude with a high level of resilience, the ability to work independently under pressure, to multitask and to focus on problem
* solving in a complex environment collaborating with international teams
* Willingness to extensively travel internationally on short notice and work flexible hours 

About the Team

Our Gas Services team offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

#RPO

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.
But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Finance Process Manager (m/f/d)

(permanent, full-time) Join our team at our location in Münster, Varberg or Verl - flexible working conditions available

Your tasks:

- As part of a team of eight within Operational Finance, you Collaborate with cross-functional and multidisciplinary teams within BU Pay & Credit to implement process changes.
- Act as the main point of contact for new products within Operational Finance CBS, ensuring the correct design and implementation of finance processes across all countries.
- Support and contribute to efficient General Ledger (GL) processes.
- Take ownership of the GL setup as a Subject Matter Expert, driving product innovations and continuous improvements.
- Design and model digital accounting and booking processes and translate them into clear system requirements.
- Act as the key interface for operational and financial topics between Operational Finance, IT, platform teams, and other relevant stakeholders.

Qualifications

Your Profil:

- You have successfully completed a degree in business administration, business mathematics, business informatics or comparable training with relevant professional experience
- You have practical experience in financial management
- You have strong analytical and conceptual skills as well as problem-solving skills
- You combine a keen interest in IT with strong Microsoft 365 skills
- You enjoy communicating confidently in written and spoken English

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here (https://bertelsmann-hr.de/docs/Overview_of_Data_Retention_Periods_EN.pdf) .

jobs.description:
Company

Operating on a global scale through an international sales and distribution network, tk accelis Trading, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Trading, is your partner for long-term success. With our local contacts around the world we are represented where the customers need us. Our core capabilities embrace complex logistic services for raw and finished steel materials along with supply chain dependability and consultancy for the downstream manufacturing and metalworking industries.

Your responsibilities

Build and scale profitable physical steel trading flows, with particular emphasis on cross-border and third-country trading. Sales market focus is EMEA. We are open to candidates trading steel products, including flat products, long products, semi-finished products, or finished goods (steel derivates). More important than a specific product background is a demonstrable ability to originate repeatable, profitable international trade flows.

- Leverage in-depth commercial and technical knowledge of steel products and specifications to support profitable trading activities.
- Identify, establish, and expand sourcing opportunities and supplier relationships across global markets.
- Build, maintain, and strengthen long-term relationships with customers and suppliers on a national and international level.
- Manage the full trading cycle, including origination, pricing, negotiation, contracting, execution, receivables management, and PundL accountability.
- Develop new procurement and sales channels to drive business growth and increase market penetration.
- Collaborate effectively within a multinational environment while utilizing a strong regional and international network to expand business opportunities.
- Develop and manage a trading book to achieve agreed volume, gross margin, EBIT, working capital, and risk targets.

Your profile

- 8+ years of proven experience in physical steel trading with a strong track record of commercial success.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, combined with a confident and professional presence.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to drive business growth while operating within corporate governance frameworks.
- Strong risk assessment capabilities to support profitable trading decisions.
- High level of integrity and thorough understanding of compliance, sanctions, competition law, and reputational risk considerations.
- Team-oriented professional with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multinational environment; prior leadership experience is an advantage.
- Based in Germany, preferably in Essen, with excellent English language skills; German is a plus.

- A competitive compensation package with performance-related incentives
- A wide range of responsibilities within a highly motivated team, where you can shape your role as you see fit
- Excellent career prospects and professional development opportunities to help you progress within the company

We have caught your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application via the ‘Apply Now’ button!

Are you passionate about cardiovascular science and dedicated to ensuring patient health and safety? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
Our CRM team is seeking an experienced Lead Patient Safety Physician with expertise in cardiovascular, renal, and/or metabolic diseases. In this pivotal role, you will contribute to one of Boehringer Ingelheim's priority assets in late-stage clinical development, making a meaningful impact on patient safety worldwide.
This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.

- Lead, manage, and provide medical-scientific direction to a team of Patient Safety Physicians responsible for a compound/asset, including project management, project-specific guidance, team coaching, and review of team output

- Develop proactive patient-centric risk minimization strategies for assigned assets on a global scale

- Medical Doctor with strong clinical and/or clinical research experience
- Profound experience in patient safety at a pharmaceutical company on a global/corporate level, including clinical development and post-marketing safety

- Broad knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry, and interest in future trends and developments in pharmacovigilance
- Clinical or research experience in the cardio-renal-metabolic field
- Proven leadership, people management & project management skills
- Excellent collaboration, communication, and negotiation skills
- Strong ethical sense with a quality and patient centricity mindset
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken

As a Control Specification Engineer (f/m/d) for Gas Turbine Auxiliaries, you work on open-loop control and protection specifications throughout the entire lifecycle of auxiliary systems, from concept development to commissioning support. You collaborate with engineers, suppliers, instrumentation specialists, and commissioning teams to align technical requirements and ensure seamless system integration. You work in an international environment with colleagues from diverse technical and cultural backgrounds.

* Responsibility for reference engineering and control specification development for gas turbine fuel systems
* Technical ownership of auxiliary systems, including control, protection, and functional performance aspects
* Coordination and clarification of interfaces with engineering teams, suppliers, commissioning personnel, and other stakeholders
* Creation and maintenance of automation specifications, parameter lists, interface documentation, and related technical documents
* Support for customer-specific engineering requirements and project adaptations
* Back-office support for site activities, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues

* Degree in mechanical engineering, process engineering, or a comparable technical field

* Strong analytical mindset and systematic approach to solving technical challenges

* Strong communication and coordination skills for interdisciplinary collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities.
